overview: Government Contact Centre Arabic Knowledge addresses staff search multiple approved sources manually and struggle to preserve permissions and version context in government and public sector operations. The first proof of value uses approved service FAQs, policy circulars and query transcripts. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is accurate first-contact resolution, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: approved service FAQs, policy circulars and query transcripts; define accurate first-contact resolution and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Government CIO / Agency Operations Director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including golden question set with prompt-injection and authorization tests.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
